title: What Field Enumeration Costs to Compile in C++26: Native Reflection, Structured-Binding Packs, Reflection Libraries and Hand-Written Serializers on GCC 16
abstract: arXiv:2611.30250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: C++26 adds standard ways to enumerate a struct's fields, among them static reflection (P2996, with P3394 annotations) and structured-binding packs (P1061), alongside hand-written code, X-macros and libraries (Boost.PFR, reflect-cpp, Glaze) that now ship pre-C++26 and C++26 paths. We time each in a struct serializer with byte-identical output on GCC 16.2.0, at the front end and at -O2, in randomized interleaved rounds with code-level checks of every single-factor contrast. At the front end, inline native enumeration in the form used in several of P2996's own examples, an expansion statement over the std::span of define_static_array, costs about as much per struct of 16 scalar fields as Boost.PFR and 7.96x a P1061 pack, itself about as cheap as hand-written code. translated_title: C++26 中字段枚举的编译成本：GCC 16 上的原生反射、结构化绑定包、反射库与手写序列化器
translated_abstract: C++26 增加了枚举结构体字段的标准方法，其中包括静态反射（P2996，附带 P3394 注解）和结构化绑定包（P1061），此外还有手写代码、X 宏以及目前同时提供 C++26 之前路径和 C++26 路径的各类库（Boost.PFR、reflect-cpp、Glaze）。我们在 GCC 16.2.0 上，在输出字节完全相同的结构体序列化器中对每种方法进行了计时，测量分别在前端和 -O2 阶段进行，采用随机交错轮次，并通过代码级检查验证每一个单因素对比。在前端，以 P2996 自身多个示例中所用形式呈现的内联原生枚举——即对 define_static_array 的 std::span 进行展开的展开语句——对于具有 16 个标量字段的结构体，其单次成本大约与 Boost.PFR 相当，是 P1061 包的 7.96 倍，而 P1061 包本身与手写代码一样廉价。对常量数组执行相同循环的成本仅为 0.47 倍：span 形式约一半的成本来自 span 本身。在异构类型图上以及……（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统测量了 C++26 各类字段枚举方案（原生反射、结构化绑定包、反射库与手写序列化代码）在 GCC 16 上的编译开销，发现基于 span 的原生反射枚举比结构化绑定包慢约 7.96 倍，而改用常量数组循环可将开销降低约一半以上。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically benchmarks the compile-time costs of C++26 field-enumeration approaches (native reflection, structured-binding packs, reflection libraries, and hand-written serializers) on GCC 16, finding that span-based native reflection enumeration is about 7.96x slower than P1061 packs, while a constant-array loop cuts that overhead by more than half.
